title_as_printed: Classification, Prediction, and Concordance of Cognitive and Functional Progression in Patients with Mild Cognitive Impairment in the United States: A Latent Class Analysis
pdf_problem: The pack extract (pdf/P-1265.txt) is not the mapped paper. It is Mouchet et al., J Alzheimers Dis 82 (2021) 1667-1682, DOI 10.3233/JAD-210305, a NACC latent-class study and the source of P-941 in summaries.md. data/paper_pdf_map.json points P-1265 at downloads/1. Clinical Assessments, Behavioral and Social Factors/PMID_34219723_jad-82-jad210305.pdf (method folder-scan, score 0.7), although its title field names the serum glutamate paper. The same Mouchet file is also mapped to P-630 and P-941. Scanning downloads/ for the mapped title found the correct PDF: downloads/3. Molecular, Genetic and Fluid Biomarkers/1-s2.0-S0967586824003679-main.pdf (Gao Y, Zhang H, Hu Y, J Clin Neurosci 129 (2024) 110828, DOI 10.1016/j.jocn.2024.110828). The P-1265 block in summaries.md and the registry row both describe that paper. All blind codes and verdicts below come from the correct PDF, coded blind before the codes file was opened. The extract is saved at scratchpad/r18_p6_work/p6_P-1265_correct.txt and page numbers refer to it.
coded_from_title: Baseline serum glutamate: Implications for diagnosis and prediction in mild cognitive impairment and Alzheimer’s disease of the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative

Task_Type.reason: A multi-aim study of a single biomarker, with two honest readings. T2: the headline positive result is MCI-to-AD conversion prediction (sMCI vs pMCI groups; a Cox model in MCI shows lower serum Glu predicts a higher conversion hazard), which meets the rule of an explicit MCI-to-AD conversion task. T4: serum Glu is analysed through group-mean differences, Spearman correlations with CSF and cognition, and a hazard ratio, and the one discrimination analysis (ROC against CN) was null. T1 is a minor third reading, since AUCs against CN are reported.
Task_Type.quote: Lower levels of serum Glu could predict the progression from MCI to AD.

Category.reason: Serum targeted metabolomics (Biocrates p180, LC-MS/MS) plus CSF Abeta/tau; cognitive scores appear only as correlates (C5 secondary).
Category.quote: employing a targeted metabolomics approach to quantitatively measure metabolites in serum

Validation_Type.reason: In-sample ROC and Cox analyses with no cross-validation, test partition or external cohort.

Sample_N_Approx.quote: This study included 783 participants from the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative-1 (ADNI-1) cohort, categorized into cognitively normal (CN, n = 224), stable MCI (sMCI, n = 181), progressive MCI (pMCI, n = 193), and AD (n = 185).

ADNI_Dependent.quote: The 783 participants were selected from the ADNI-1 cohort
